targetAthlete: High School Defensive Linemen (DE / DT / NT)
weeklyScheduleNote: Recommended 4-day offseason split: Mon (Upper Body), Tue (Lower Body), Wed (Recovery/Mobility), Thu (Explosive Day), Fri (Running & Agility Day), Sat/Sun (Rest & Fuel).

phases.name: Phase 1: Foundation & Work Capacity
phases.focus: Clean technique, joint tendon durability, muscle hypertrophy, and aerobic base for trench endurance.
phases.coachingNote: Own every rep. Control the eccentric (lowering) for 2 seconds before driving explosively.

phases.name: Phase 2: Max Strength & Force Production
phases.focus: Heavy compound force, anchor leg strength against double teams, and heavy upper-body lockout.
phases.coachingNote: Add 5–10 lbs per week only when bar speed and posture stay locked in.

phases.name: Phase 3: Explosive Power & Speed Peak
phases.focus: Convert offseason strength into violent first-step get-off, hand speed, and combine-ready sprint mechanics.
phases.rpeTarget: RPE 8–9 on primary lifts; 100% intent on sprints & jumps
phases.coachingNote: Move moderate-heavy weights as fast as physically possible. Never grind ugly reps in peak phase.

workoutDays.title: Day 1: Upper Body — Lockout & Punch Strength
workoutDays.subtitle: Pressing power, violent shed-and-pull back thickness, shoulder armor
workoutDays.primaryGoal: Build heavy bench/press punch strength and thick upper-back pulling power to shock and shed offensive linemen.
warmUp: 3 min jump rope or brisk incline walk
World's greatest stretch + thoracic rotations: 5 reps each side

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.dLineTransfer: Two-hand punch extension and keeping blockers off your chest
exercises.coachingCue: Pin shoulder blades into the bench, feet glued to the floor, drive elbows at 45 degrees.

phase-3.intensityCue: Max bar speed on every press (RPE 8.5)

exercises.name: Barbell Bent-Over Row
exercises.dLineTransfer: Ripping offensive linemen off your frame and controlling gaps
exercises.coachingCue: Hinge at hips with a flat back, pull bar toward lower ribs, pause 1 second at chest.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.dLineTransfer: Upward strike angle under an offensive tackle's pads
exercises.coachingCue: Set bench at 30 degrees; press up and slightly inward without clanking dumbbells.

exercises.name: Weighted or Band-Assisted Chin-Ups
exercises.dLineTransfer: Lat width, grip endurance, and arm-over pass-rush control
exercises.coachingCue: Start from dead hang, drive elbows down to ribs until chin clears bar.

phase-2.intensityCue: Add belt weight or slow 3s negative

exercises.name: Split-Stance Landmine Single-Arm Press
exercises.dLineTransfer: Violent single-arm club/punch from a staggered D-line stance
exercises.coachingCue: Lock ribcage down, punch through hip and shoulder as one unit.

phase-2.intensityCue: Explosive punch out of the pocket

exercises.name: Face Pulls + Heavy Farmer's Walk (Superset)
exercises.equipment: Cable/Band + Heavy Dumbbells or Trap Bar
exercises.dLineTransfer: Shoulder injury prevention + vice-grip jersey/wrist strength
exercises.coachingCue: Pull rope to forehead with thumbs back; walk tall with packed shoulders.

coolDown: Lat hang or child's pose reach: 60 sec
Hydrate + post-lift protein/carb recovery within 45 min

drillSlot.title: D-Line Upper-Body / Hand-Combat Drills Slot
drillSlot.description: Reserved for coach-added hand-fighting, punch-and-rip, and pad-shed drills.
drillSlot.suggestedTiming: Run 10–15 min before lifting or on turf right after warm-up.

workoutDays.title: Day 2: Lower Body — Hip Drive & Double-Team Anchor
workoutDays.subtitle: Squat/hinge force, posterior chain armor, single-leg stability
workoutDays.primaryGoal: Build unmovable lower-body leverage, low pad-level hip power, and knee/hamstring durability.
warmUp: 5 min bike or brisk sled drag backward

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat (or Safety Bar Squat)
exercises.dLineTransfer: Pad-level leverage, anchoring against double teams, vertical drive
exercises.coachingCue: Brace 360-degree belly breath, sit hips between heels to parallel, drive floor away.

phase-3.intensityCue: Explosive drive out of the hole (RPE 8)

exercises.name: Trap Bar Deadlift (Low or High Handles)
exercises.dLineTransfer: Raw starting-stance hip extension and total-body ground force
exercises.coachingCue: Push feet through the turf like a leg press, keep chest proud, lock hips tall.

phase-1.intensityCue: Reset every rep on the floor (RPE 7)

exercises.name: Barbell or Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
exercises.dLineTransfer: Hamstring/glute resilience during sprinting and low-pad tackles
exercises.coachingCue: Soft knees, push hips straight back until hamstrings load, snap hips forward.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.dLineTransfer: Single-leg drive when redirecting around guards or chasing outside zone
exercises.coachingCue: Keep front shin mostly vertical, drive through whole front foot.

phase-1.intensityCue: Bodyweight or light DBs for balance

exercises.name: Standing Single-Leg or Barbell Calf Raise
exercises.dLineTransfer: Achilles stiffness and ankle pop on your first step out of a 3-point stance
exercises.coachingCue: Pause 2 seconds at bottom stretch, drive high onto big toe.

exercises.name: Pallof Press + Hanging Knee/Leg Raises
exercises.dLineTransfer: Anti-rotation core stability so blockers can't torque your torso
exercises.coachingCue: Exhale hard, keep ribs stacked over pelvis, zero swinging.

drillSlot.title: D-Line Stance, Get-Off & Pad-Level Drills Slot
drillSlot.description: Reserved for coach-added 3-point/4-point stance explosion and chute/leverage drills.
drillSlot.suggestedTiming: Run on turf right after dynamic warm-up while legs are fresh.

workoutDays.title: Day 3: Explosive Day — Triple Extension & Violent Power
workoutDays.subtitle: Olympic pulls, plyometrics, med-ball shock, heavy sled bursts
workoutDays.primaryGoal: Train fast-twitch rate of force development so strength translates to sudden knock-back on contact.
warmUp: 3 min dynamic skips (A-skip, B-skip, lateral carioca)
Empty barbell clean pulls + front squat prep: 2 × 5

exercises.name: Hang Power Clean (from mid-thigh)
exercises.dLineTransfer: Violent hip-to-hand triple extension on snap count
exercises.coachingCue: Shins vertical, sweep bar close, jump & punch elbows fast to catch in quarter squat.
exercises.alternative: Trap Bar Jump Shrug or Heavy KB Swing

phase-3.intensityCue: Peak bar velocity, zero sloppy catches

exercises.name: Seated-to-Standing Box Jump
exercises.dLineTransfer: Dead-stop concentric explosion out of a 3-point stance
exercises.coachingCue: Sit with shins vertical, pause 1 sec (no rock-back), explode up and land soft like a cat.

phase-2.intensityCue: Max height intent, step down every rep

exercises.name: Broad Jump (Stick the Landing)
exercises.dLineTransfer: Horizontal displacement off the line of scrimmage
exercises.coachingCue: Load arms back, drive hips forward at 45 degrees, stick athletic landing for 2 sec.

exercises.name: Med Ball Stance-to-Wall Explosive Chest Pass
exercises.dLineTransfer: Instant hand strike power on offensive tackle's breastplate
exercises.coachingCue: Start in staggered DL stance, step front foot 6 inches and fire ball straight through the wall.

exercises.name: Heavy Low-Pad Sled Drive (10–15 Yards)
exercises.dLineTransfer: Driving an offensive guard backward on bull-rush or goal-line stand
exercises.coachingCue: 45-degree torso angle, arms locked/semi-locked, piston knees hard into the turf.

exercises.name: Rotational Med Ball Slam
exercises.dLineTransfer: Hip-to-shoulder torque for swim/rip/spin rush moves
exercises.coachingCue: Pivot back foot, whip hips first then slam ball violently beside front foot.

coolDown: Deep diaphragmatic nasal breathing (lie feet elevated): 2 min
Quad/hip flexor stretch + shoulder circles: 2 min

drillSlot.title: D-Line Pass-Rush & Ball-Get-Off Drills Slot
drillSlot.description: Reserved for coach-added ball-reaction get-offs, hoop/corner drills, and rush moves.
drillSlot.suggestedTiming: Execute immediately after dynamic warm-up before heavy sleds.

workoutDays.title: Day 4: Running Day — Get-Off Speed, Agility & Trench Conditioning
workoutDays.subtitle: Short-area acceleration, change of direction, and high-output repeat effort
workoutDays.primaryGoal: Shave tenths off your 10-yd split and 5-10-5 shuttle while building repeat-sprint conditioning with real football rest intervals.
warmUp: 400m easy jog or 3 min jump rope
High knees, butt kicks, A-march, lateral shuffles: 20 yds each

exercises.name: 10-Yard Stance Get-Off Sprints
exercises.dLineTransfer: Winning the first 3 steps off the snap against offensive tackles
exercises.coachingCue: No false step. Push off front foot, stay low through step 4, rip arms cheek-to-hip.

exercises.name: 20-Yard & 40-Yard Sprint Mechanics
exercises.dLineTransfer: Closing speed on screen plays, QB scrambles, and combine testing
exercises.coachingCue: Stay patient rising tall between 10–20 yds; relax jaw and shoulders at top speed.

phase-3.intensityCue: Full recovery, PR attempt every 2 weeks

exercises.name: Pro Agility Shuttle (5-10-5)
exercises.dLineTransfer: Plant-and-redirect agility when chasing counter, reverse, or cutback runs
exercises.coachingCue: Drop hips on the line touch, push outside foot into turf, drive head & chest back across.

exercises.name: 3-Cone L-Drill (Edge Bend & Hip Turn)
exercises.dLineTransfer: Bending the corner past an offensive tackle to sack the quarterback
exercises.coachingCue: Dip inside shoulder tight around the far cone, keep feet churning under hips.

phase-2.intensityCue: Drop shoulder low on corner turn

exercises.name: D-Line Tempo Half-Gassers / Turf Shuttles
exercises.dLineTransfer: 4th-quarter pass-rush gas tank without turning fast-twitch legs into slow joggers
exercises.coachingCue: Run sharp 85% strides (not jogging), hit each line clean, breathe deeply during rest.

coolDown: 200m slow walk until heart rate settles
Calf, hamstring, and groin static stretch: 30 sec each
Drink 20–24 oz water + electrolytes/pinch of salt

drillSlot.title: D-Line Pursuit, Screen-Read & Bag Drills Slot
drillSlot.description: Reserved for coach-added pursuit angles, wave drills, and agility bag footwork.
drillSlot.suggestedTiming: Place between 10-yd starts and final conditioning.
